prompt.en: A local VHF station uses a vertical whip. Which receiving antenna orientation is usually the better first choice?

text.en: Horizontal, because it rejects all ground-wave signals
Any orientation, because polarization only applies to feedlines
Circular, because all whips are circularly polarized

explanation.en: For local VHF/UHF paths, matching polarization usually improves received signal strength.

prompt.en: A wire antenna resonates below the frequency you want. What adjustment moves resonance upward?

text.en: Add more wire to both ends
Make the radiating wire a little shorter
Replace the end insulators with longer rope

explanation.en: Shorter antennas resonate higher; longer antennas resonate lower.

prompt.en: Using λ = 300 / f(MHz), what is the free-space wavelength of a 60 MHz signal?

explanation.en: 300 divided by 60 is 5, so the wavelength is about 5 metres.
